brief:
Israeli forces are holding 40 journalists in detention facilities, according to Ma'an news agency. The arrests represent a significant number of media workers incarcerated across the occupied Palestinian territories. No details were available regarding the specific identities of the detained journalists, the locations where they are being held, or the charges filed against them.

The detentions underscore ongoing restrictions on press freedom in Palestinian areas under Israeli control. Journalists working in the occupied territories have faced repeated arrest and harassment during their coverage of events.
title: Israeli occupation holds 40 journalists in detention
